## What's new in 0.1.3

- **Fast with thousands of tasks.** The task list now builds only the rows on screen. With
  about 2,000 tasks a frame used to take around 100 ms of CPU, so scrolling and hovering lagged;
  now it takes about 4 ms, the same as with a few dozen tasks. The arrow keys scroll the selected
  task into view.
- **Less work per change.** Reloading a view reads the tasks once instead of once per filter.
  Tag counts use an index. Database queries are prepared once, and saving a change no longer
  waits for the disk.
- **Statistics, the Eisenhower Matrix and Today's habits** load their data with the view
  instead of on every frame.
